name: fractal-factory-task-graph-methodology-shift
versionNote: Initial plan. Phase 0 implemented; phases 1–5 planned.
description: Migrate Fractal Factory from pass-state + roster-lifecycle execution to production-graph-driven execution. Extract invariants from domain-model.json into classified separate files.
designDecisions: Invariants extracted from domain-model.json into .fractal-factory/invariants/ with one file per classification (behavioral, structural, quality, workflow).
production-graph.json becomes the sole runtime-state artifact; roster.json, architecture.json, test-plan.json, domain-model.json become stateless constraints.
Tasks reference constraint artifacts by ID, not by copying content — factory prompt-writers read constraints directly.
Gap hunting mutates the production graph (add/annotate tasks) instead of resetting passes.
Per-task verification hooks replace the monolithic package-level verification pass.

phases.name: Invariant Storage Restructuring
phases.description: Extract invariants from domain-model.json into .fractal-factory/invariants/ directory with per-classification files. Update all reading and writing agents.

phases.name: Production Graph Schema & Planner
phases.description: Define production-graph.json schema. Create the production-graph-planner agent. Update planning coordinator dispatch.

phases.name: Execution Rewrite
phases.description: Rewrite execution-coordinator from batch-loop to dependency-gated task selection. Update prompt-writer and prompt-reviewer for single-task mode.

phases.name: Verification Shift
phases.description: Move verification from package-level to per-task hooks in the production graph. Demote checklist-validator and audit-oracle.

phases.name: Gap-Hunting Graph Mutation
phases.description: Rewrite gap hunters to add/annotate production graph nodes. Remove pass-reset logic from the session orchestrator.

phases.name: Roster Cleanup
phases.description: Remove status lifecycle field from roster.json. Update progress.json for graph-level tracking.

tasks.title: Update invariant-extractor to write per-classification files
acceptanceCriteria: Invariant-extractor writes to .fractal-factory/invariants/{classification}.json instead of domain-model.json.invariants
Each classification file has envelope: { classification, lastUpdated, entries: [] }
On re-entry, extractor reads existing entries from all 4 files, preserving entries from other agents
ID assignment continues from highest existing ID across all classification files

tasks.title: Update domain-scanner to initialize invariants directory
acceptanceCriteria: Domain-scanner no longer initializes an empty invariants array in domain-model.json
Domain-scanner notes that invariants are stored separately in .fractal-factory/invariants/

tasks.title: Update coverage-hunter to read from invariants directory
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage-hunter reads .fractal-factory/invariants/*.json instead of domain-model.json.invariants
Methodology description references the invariants directory, not the domain-model invariants array

tasks.title: Update domain-model.schema.md to remove invariants section
acceptanceCriteria: Schema no longer contains invariants array definition
Schema references .fractal-factory/invariants/ for invariant storage
Invariant classification and confidence tables moved to a note or stub

tasks.title: Update prompt-writer to reference invariants directory
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt-writer reads invariants from .fractal-factory/invariants/*.json, not domain-model.json

tasks.title: Update test-planner to reference invariants directory
acceptanceCriteria: Test-planner reads invariants from .fractal-factory/invariants/*.json
Invariant-driven test scenarios reference invariants by ID from the classified files

tasks.title: Update checklist-validator to reference invariants directory
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist-validator reads invariants from .fractal-factory/invariants/*.json
Invariant-enforceable check references the new location

tasks.title: Update README artifact directory and references
acceptanceCriteria: Artifact directory listing shows invariants/ directory instead of invariants in domain-model.json
Input requirements table still references invariants.md as user input
Discovery coordinator flow mentions invariants directory

tasks.title: Consistency pass across all Phase 0 changes
acceptanceCriteria: No agent references domain-model.json.invariants for reading or writing
All invariant references point to .fractal-factory/invariants/ directory
Consistent terminology across all modified files

tasks.title: Create production-graph.schema.md
acceptanceCriteria: Schema defines task node structure: id, name, description, category, rosterAgentIds, dependsOn, status, priority, scope (with constraintRefs), acceptanceCriteria, verificationHooks, retryHistory, addedBy, addedInCycle, gapAnnotations
Task status lifecycle: planned → in-progress → implemented → verified | blocked | failed-review
Category enum: orchestrator-prompt, coordinator-prompt, specialist-prompt, guide-prompt, skill, schema, bootstrap, documentation, test-fixture
ConstraintRefs structure: rosterEntry, architecturePass, testScenarios, invariants (by ID)
Summary section with counts by status and category

tasks.title: Create fractal-factory-production-graph-planner agent
acceptanceCriteria: Agent reads roster.json, architecture.json, test-plan.json, domain-model.json, and invariants/*.json
Decomposes into discrete tasks: one per agent prompt, one per skill, one per schema, one bootstrap, documentation, test-fixture groups
Generates explicit dependsOn edges following hierarchy: specialist → coordinator → orchestrator → docs → bootstrap
Each task carries constraintRefs pointing to source artifact entries by ID
Each task has per-task acceptanceCriteria and verificationHooks
Status contract with result code: planned

tasks.title: Update planning-coordinator to dispatch production-graph-planner
acceptanceCriteria: Routing table dispatches production-graph-planner after test-planner
Planning coordinator reports complete only after all 4 children finish: roster-planner → routing-planner → test-planner → production-graph-planner

tasks.title: Update session orchestrator roster and README
acceptanceCriteria: Agent roster in README includes production-graph-planner under planning-coordinator
Total agent count updated to 36

tasks.title: Rewrite execution-coordinator for dependency-gated task selection
acceptanceCriteria: Reads production-graph.json to find next eligible task (status=planned, all dependsOn=verified)
Dispatches category-appropriate writer for single task
Dispatches reviewer with per-task acceptanceCriteria
Retry loop per-task (not per-batch)
Sets task status: planned → in-progress → implemented → verified | blocked
No longer uses roster.json status field for work selection
No longer uses batch sizing logic

tasks.title: Update prompt-writer for single-task mode
acceptanceCriteria: Receives a single task ID, not a batch
Reads task.scope.constraintRefs to find relevant roster entry, architecture pass, invariants
Writes one prompt file per invocation
Updates production-graph.json task status to implemented on success
No longer reads roster.json status for batch selection

tasks.title: Update prompt-reviewer for per-task acceptance
acceptanceCriteria: Receives a single task ID
Validates against per-task acceptanceCriteria from production-graph.json
Runs verificationHooks declared by the task
Returns approved/rejected for that one task
No longer batch-reviews

tasks.title: Define verification hook types in production-graph schema
acceptanceCriteria: verificationHooks enum: structural-checklist, routing-audit, contract-check, anti-laziness, content-check, format-validation, purity-check, test-coverage, trigger-accuracy
Each hook type has a description of what it validates
Hook-to-category mapping documented (which hooks apply to which task categories)

tasks.title: Update verification-coordinator for task-level hooks
acceptanceCriteria: Verification runs per-task during execution, not as a separate pass
Checklist-validator becomes a final cross-reference sanity check
Audit-oracle becomes a final cross-reference sanity check
Both still run after all tasks are verified, as a safety net

tasks.title: Demote checklist-validator to cross-reference check
acceptanceCriteria: Primary verification is per-task hooks (run inline during execution)
Checklist-validator runs post-completion as final cross-reference sanity check
Still reports pass/fail, but findings at this stage should be rare

tasks.title: Demote audit-oracle to cross-reference check
acceptanceCriteria: Same shift as checklist-validator
Audit oracle runs post-completion rather than as primary verification

tasks.title: Update coverage-hunter for graph mutation
acceptanceCriteria: Writes new task nodes to production-graph.json for missing coverage
Annotates existing tasks with gapAnnotations for enforcement gaps
No longer writes standalone gap entries to gap-report.json
Sets addedBy: coverage-hunter and addedInCycle on new tasks

tasks.title: Update artifact-hunter for graph mutation
acceptanceCriteria: Same pattern as coverage-hunter: writes to production-graph.json
New task nodes for missing artifacts, annotations for existing tasks

tasks.title: Update infrastructure-hunter for graph mutation
acceptanceCriteria: Same pattern: writes to production-graph.json
New task nodes for missing infrastructure, annotations for existing tasks

tasks.title: Update gap-hunting-coordinator for graph aggregation
acceptanceCriteria: Reads production-graph.json for new/annotated tasks instead of aggregating gap-report.json
Reports converged if no new tasks or annotations were added
Reports gaps-found if graph was mutated
No longer writes gap-report.json

tasks.title: Remove pass-reset logic from session orchestrator
acceptanceCriteria: Orchestrator no longer resets passes on gap-hunting dirty result
Orchestrator no longer deletes status.json files for pass resets
Gap-hunting dirty result causes execution-coordinator to pick up new/re-planned tasks naturally
Orchestrator checks graph-level completion: all tasks verified or blocked
Cycle limit still enforced (maxGapCycles)

tasks.title: Remove status lifecycle from roster.json
acceptanceCriteria: Roster-planner no longer emits status field on agent entries
roster.json becomes a pure design artifact: names, hierarchy, result codes, reads/writes, routing tables
No lifecycle status transitions (designed→written→reviewed→verified→blocked) in roster

tasks.title: Update progress.json for graph-level tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Progress.json tracks graph-level completion: tasks by status (planned, in-progress, implemented, verified, blocked)
No longer tracks roster lifecycle counts (designed, written, reviewed, verified)
Pass status transitions remain for discovery, analysis, planning (pre-graph passes)
Execution, verification, gap-hunting pass status derived from graph state

tasks.title: Final consistency pass
acceptanceCriteria: No agent references roster.json status field for work selection
No agent references domain-model.json invariants array
All execution-phase agents reference production-graph.json
README accurately reflects the new execution model
ROUTING-ARCHITECTURE.md updated for graph-driven execution

steps.note: Phase 0: all invariant extraction changes are independent of each other
Phase 0: README update after all agent changes
Phase 0: consistency pass after all changes
Phase 1: coordinator update and roster/README can happen together
Phase 2: writer and reviewer updates are independent
Phase 4: all three hunters are independent
Phase 4: coordinator aggregation after all hunters
Phase 5: roster cleanup and progress update are independent
